title: सानु शर्माको ‘बकाइनाको बोट’ कथामा द्विचरविरोध {Dualism in Sanu Sharma's story 'Bakainako Bot'}
nepali: नेपाली साहित्यमा समकालीन समयकी कथाकार सानु शर्मा उत्तरआधुनिकतावादी प्रवृत्तिका कथाहरू रचना गर्ने कथाकार हुन् । उनले एकादेशमा कथासङ्ग्रहमा जम्मा २१ वटा कथाहरू सङ्कलन गरेकी छन् । उनका विभिन्न चर्चितकथाहरू मध्येको एउटा कथा ‘बकाइनाको बोट’ हो । यस कथामा उनले त्यहाँ उपस्थित मुख्यपात्र उज्वलको अतीतको कथावस्तु प्रस्तुत गरेकी छन् । बकाइनाको बोटलाई प्रतिबिम्बित गरी रचिएको उक्त कथामा उज्वल उक्त बकाइनाको बोटको प्रतीक हो, किनभने बकाइनाको बोटको फेदमा फेला पारेको उसलाई कर्म दिने आमाले आफूले जन्माएकाछोराहरू भन्दा पनि बढी माया गरेको देखिन्छ । पछिल्लो समयमा पाठकले अत्यन्तै रुचाएकी आख्यानकार सानु शर्माले लेखेको यो कथा लगायत अन्य विभिन्न कथाहरू उत्तिकै महत्त्वपूर्ण मानिन्छन् । ‘बकाइनाको बोट’ कथामा द्विचर विरोध शीर्षकमा तयार गरिएको यो लेख उनको ‘बकाइनाको बोट’ कथामा देखिएका द्विचरविरोधहरू पत्ता लगाई तिनीहरूलाई कसरी अस्वीकार गरिएको छ भन्ने कुराको खोजी गर्ने उद्देश्यले तयार पारिएको छ । कथाको सुरुदेखि अन्तसम्म देखिएका द्विचर विरोधहरूको बारेमा जानकारी लिई तिनीहरूको उत्तरआधुनिकतावादी मान्यताका आधारमा व्याख्या विश्लेषण गर्नुमा यो लेख सीमित रहेको छ । उक्त लेख तयार गर्नका लागि गुणात्मक विधिअन्तर्गत पर्ने पुस्तकालयीय कार्य गरिएको छ । उक्त लेख तयार गर्नका लागि सानु शर्माको ‘बकाइनाको बोट’ कथालाई प्राथमिक स्रोतका रूपमा लिइएको छ भने अन्य त्यससँग सम्बन्धित सामग्रीहरूलाई द्वितीय स्रोतका रूपमा प्रयोग गरिएको छ । यस लेखमा ‘बकाइनाको बोट’ कथामा देखिएका द्विचर विरोधहरूको बारेमा खोजी गर्नुका साथै समाजमा देखिएका त्यस्ता द्विचर विरोधहरूको के कसरी अस्वीकार गरिएको छ भन्ने कुरालाई देखाउन खोजिएको छ । समग्रमा यस अध्ययनबाट ‘बकाइनाको बोट’ कथामा देखिएका द्विचर विरोधहरूको खोजी गरी त्यसप्रतिको अस्वीकारका बारेमा विभिन्न साक्ष्यहरूका माध्यमबाट खोजी गरी निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ । समाजमा यस्ता किसिमका द्विचर विरोधहरू देखिने गरेको र केही व्यक्तिहरूले त्यस्ता विरोधप्रति असहमति जनाएको कुरालाई यस ‘बकाइनाको बोट’ कथाका माध्यमबाट यस अध्ययनले देखाउन खोजेको छ ।
american_english: In Nepali literature, Sanu Sharma, a contemporary story writer, is a writer who composes stories of postmodernist tendency. She has collected a total of 21 stories in the story collection Ekadeshma. One of her various well-known stories is 'Bakainako Bot'. In this story she has presented the past narrative of the main character Ujjwal present there. In that story written reflecting Bakainako Bot, Ujjwal is the symbol of that Bakainako Bot, because the mother who found him at the base of the Bakainako Bot and gave him work is seen to have loved him even more than the sons she gave birth to. This story written by Sanu Sharma, a fiction writer much liked by readers in recent times, along with various other stories, is considered equally important. This article prepared under the title 'Dualism in the Story Bakainako Bot' has been prepared with the objective of finding the dualisms seen in her story 'Bakainako Bot' and searching how they have been rejected. This article is limited to gathering information about the dualisms seen from the beginning to the end of the story and analyzing and interpreting them on the basis of postmodernist principles. Library work falling under qualitative method has been done to prepare that article. To prepare that article, Sanu Sharma's story 'Bakainako Bot' has been taken as the primary source, while other material related to it has been used as the secondary source. In this article, along with searching the dualisms seen in the story 'Bakainako Bot', an attempt has been made to show how such dualisms seen in society have been rejected. Overall, from this study, by searching the dualisms seen in the story 'Bakainako Bot' and the rejection of them, conclusions have been drawn through various pieces of evidence. This study has sought to show through the story 'Bakainako Bot' that such dualisms are seen in society and that some individuals have expressed disagreement with such contradictions.

informal_english: In Nepali literature, Sanu Sharma is a contemporary story writer who writes postmodernist stories. She's gathered 21 stories in total in her collection Ekadeshma. One of her best-known stories is 'Bakainako Bot'. In it she sets out the past of the main character Ujjwal. In that story, written with Bakainako Bot as its mirror, Ujjwal stands for that very Bakainako Bot, because the mother who found him at its base and put him to work is seen to have loved him even more than her own sons. This story by Sanu Sharma, a fiction writer readers have really taken to lately, along with her other stories, is considered just as important. The article stays within gathering information about the dualisms running from the start to the end of the story and reading them through a postmodernist lens. To prepare it, library work under the qualitative method was carried out. Sanu Sharma's 'Bakainako Bot' was taken as the primary source, with other related material used as the secondary source. Overall, this study draws conclusions from various pieces of evidence about the dualisms in 'Bakainako Bot' and the rejection of them. Through 'Bakainako Bot' it seeks to show that such dualisms turn up in society and that some people have voiced disagreement with them.
